title: Impilo yomhlaba nokwenza umgquba
description: Yakha umhlaba ophilayo ngomgquba, ingca yokugquma, izityalo zokugquma (cover crops) kunye neefama zeentshulube.

lessons.title: Ukuqonda umhlaba wakho: isiseko sayo yonke into
lessons.body:
Umhlaba uqulethe iintlobo ezininzi zezinto eziphilayo. Iibhaktheriya namakhowa (i-fungi) ancedisa ekubolisweni kwe-organic matter (izinto ezibolayo ezivela kwizityalo nakwizilwanyana) kwaye ajikelezise izondlo.

Amanye amakhowa ancedisa iingcambu ukuba zifumane izondlo. Iindledlana zeentshulube zinokunceda amanzi nomoya ukuba angene emhlabeni.

Jonga iingcambu, isakhiwo somhlaba nokuhamba kwamanzi, kunye nobomi bomhlaba obubonakalayo.

Faka umhlaba namanzi kwingqayi ecacileyo, kunye nedetergent encinci efanelekileyo yokwahlula amasuntswana omhlaba (dispersing detergent). Yivale uyihlokohlise, uze uyiyeke ingashukunyiswa.

Isanti iqala ukuhlala. I-silt (umhlaba ocolekileyo kunesanti) ilandela, ngelixa udongwe lunokuhlala lumi emanzini ixesha elide kakhulu.

Eli lilingelo elilula lokufunda. Izigaqa nodongwe olungekahlali zinokukulahlekisa; sebenzisa ilebhu yomhlaba xa kufuneka ubume bomhlaba (texture) buchanekile.

Umaleko oqinileyo wesanti ngaphantsi kwamanzi anamafu awukuxeleli okwangoku umlinganiselo wokugqibela. Amanye amasuntswana acolekileyo asenokuba asamile emanzini.

Thelekisa imigangatho ehleliyo uze uvavanye umhlaba ngesandla entsimini.

Bhala oko ukubonayo nako konke okuseyinto engaqinisekanga. Musa ukumisela ukunisela okanye unyango lomhlaba ngokusekelwe kwingqayi enye kuphela.

Ukuxinana komhlaba, ukungaphumi kakuhle kwamanzi nokulahleka kwe-organic matter kunokunciphisa iingcambu nobomi bomhlaba.

Umbala ophaphathekileyo okanye iintshulube ezimbalwa akungqini ukuba imichiza ibulele umhlaba. Umsebenzi weentshulube uyatshintsha nokufuma kunye nexesha lonyaka.

Jonga iipatheni kwintsimi yonke. Hlola imbali yolawulo, ukuphuma kwamanzi nokukhula kwezityalo ngaphambi kokukhetha unyango.
keyPoints: Sebenzisa imikhondo emininzi ukuvavanya imeko yomhlaba
Umbala womhlaba nenani leentshulube ngokwabo azikwazi ukuchaza unobangela wengxaki
Ilingelo lengqayi linika nje umbono ngokubanzi wobume bomhlaba, aliyovavanyo olupheleleyo lomhlaba
Hlola ukuphuma kwamanzi, iingcambu nembali yolawulo ngaphambi kokukhetha unyango

quiz.q: Ingqayi yomhlaba isenamanzi anamafu ngaphezu komaleko wesanti. Yintoni umfama okufuneka ayigqibe?
options: Umhlaba ngokuqinisekileyo ufuna amanzi ambalwa
Amasuntswana acolekileyo asenokuba asamile emanzini; kufuneka ukubukela okungakumbi
Lonke udongwe sele luhlale
Isityalo ngokuqinisekileyo sifuna i-gypsum
quiz.rationale: Amanzi anamafu anokuba namasuntswana acolekileyo angekahlali. Ukubona kwangethuba kanye akunakuseka umlinganiselo wokugqibela okanye unyango olululo.

quiz.q: Umfama ufumana umhlaba oxinene neentshulube ezimbalwa. Leliphi inyathelo eliluncedo elilandelayo?
options: Cinga ukuba zonke izinto eziphilayo zomhlaba sezifile
Yongeza unyango ungayihlolanga indawo
Hlola ukuphuma kwamanzi, iingcambu, ukufuma nembali yolawulo
Yeka kuba umhlaba awunakuphucuka
quiz.rationale: Ukubona izinto ezininzi kunceda ukuchonga ingxaki. Umsebenzi weentshulube uyahluka ngokweemeko, ngoko iintshulube ezimbalwa ngokwazo azibonisi unobangela wayo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Isahlulo somhlaba sibonisa umhlaba ongaphezulu omnyama ngaphezu komhlaba ongaphantsi ophaphathekileyo, kunye neentshulube ezimbini. Ecaleni kwawo, ingqayi yomhlaba ihlala ibe ngamaleko amathathu — isanti, i-silt nodongwe.

lessons.title: Ukwenza nokusebenzisa umgquba
lessons.body:
Umgquba yi-organic matter ebolisiweyo phantsi kweemeko ezilawulwayo.

Umgquba ogqityiweyo unokuphucula isakhiwo somhlaba kwaye unegalelo kwizondlo.

Ixesha lokulunga liyahluka ngokweempahla, ukufuma, umoya nobushushu. Igama lephondo okanye inani elimiselweyo leeveki asiso isivivinyo sokulunga.

Xuba i-browns ezomileyo (izinto ezomileyo ezinsundu) ne-greens ezintsha (izinto ezintsha eziluhlaza). Phepha imigangatho eshinyeneyo, emanzi evala umoya.

Ukuba inqwaba iba bushelelezi okanye inuka kakhulu i-ammonia, yongeza i-browns ezomileyo uyiguqule.

Hlola ukufuma nomoya njengoko inqwaba itshintsha; iresiphi enye ayifaneli zonke ngxubevange zeempahla.

Iqondo eliphakathi elishushu aliqinisekisi ukuba yonke inxalenye yenqwaba iphathiwe. Ixesha, ubushushu nolawulo zonke ziyabalulekile.

Musa ukufaka inyama, ubisi neemveliso zobisi, izityalo ezigulayo, inkunkuma yezilwanyana zasekhaya nezinto ezingcolisiweyo kule nkqubo ilula yasekhaya.

Musa ukucinga ukuba ukwenza umgquba ekhaya kutshabalalisa yonke imbewu yokhula okanye zonke izinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo. Sebenzisa inkqubo eqatshelwayo apho kufuneka ucoceko.

Musa ukufaka amaqokobhe embewu (seed pods) ye-wattle enqwabeni yomgquba. Inqwaba eqhelekileyo isenokungawenzi yonke imbewu ingakwazi ukukhula.

Sebenzisa kuphela izinto ezicocekileyo, ezingaphathwanga. Ixolo lomthi libola ngokucotha; ukuba lixolo kuphela akuqinisekisi ukuba alinakungcola.

Hlola inqwaba uyiguqule xa ifuna umoya okanye ukuxutywa okungakumbi. Yigcine ifumile kunokuba izele ngamanzi.
keyPoints: Iqondo eliphakathi elishushu aliqinisekisi ukuba yonke inqwaba ibulele iintsholongwane nembewu
Musa ukufaka amaqokobhe embewu (seed pods) nezinto ezingcolisiweyo
Gweba ukulunga komgquba ngemeko yawo, hayi ngetayimtheyibhile emiselweyo yengingqi

quiz.q: Inqwaba yomgquba yomfama inuka kakhulu i-ammonia kwaye imanzi inebushelelezi. Sisiphi isisombululo?
options: Yongeza izinto ezintsha eziluhlaza ezityebileyo nge-nitrogen
Yongeza izinto ezomileyo ezityebileyo nge-carbon njenge-straw uze uyiguqule inqwaba
Yeka ukuyiguqula uyiyeke ipholile
Yongeza amanzi amaninzi — ivumba lithetha ukuba yomile kakhulu
quiz.rationale: Inqwaba emanzi, ebushelelezi isenokufuna umoya omkhulu nezinto ezomileyo ezingakumbi. Yongeza i-browns ezomileyo uguqule inqwaba ukuze uyivule. Ivumba le-ammonia lisenokuthetha nokuba kukho izinto ezininzi kakhulu ezityebileyo nge-nitrogen. Qinisekisa ukuba inqwaba ihlala ifumile, ingaxhaphakanga manzi.

quiz.q: Kutheni kungafakwa amaqokobhe embewu (seed pods) ye-wattle enqwabeni yomgquba eqhelekileyo?
options: Ixolo lenza zonke iinqwaba zishushu kakhulu
Enye imbewu isenokuphila yasasazeke xa umgquba usetyenziswa
Amaqokobhe embewu ahlala etsala ii-termite
Amaqokobhe embewu akhupha irhasi ebulala zonke izinto eziphilayo zomhlaba
quiz.rationale: Inqwaba eqhelekileyo isenokungazityhilela zonke iimbewu kwiimeko ezizenza zingakwazi ukukhula. Ukungawafaki amaqokobhe embewu kuphepha ukuwasasaza kunye nomgquba.

lessons.infographicAlt: Inqwaba yomgquba isikiwe yavulwa, ibonisa imigangatho elandelelanayo yezinto ezomileyo ezinsundu nezinto ezintsha eziluhlaza, ubushushu bunyuka ephakathi, kunye notolo olubonisa ukuguqulwa kwayo.

lessons.title: Ukugquma umhlaba nezityalo zokugquma: ukukhusela nokwakha umhlaba
lessons.body:
Gquma umhlaba ongenanto ngengca yokugquma (mulch) efanelekileyo necocekileyo, njenge-straw, ingca eyomileyo okanye iziqwengana zomthi.

Ingca yokugquma inokunciphisa ukuphuma kwamanzi ngomphunga, ithambise ukubetha kwemvula kwaye ithintele ukhula.

Yigcine kude neziqu zemithi nezezityalo. Hlola ukufuma ngaphantsi uze ulungise umaleko; ingca yokugquma eninzi ayisoloko ilunge ngakumbi.

Izityalo zokugquma (cover crops) zinokukhusela umhlaba phakathi kwezityalo eziphambili. Khetha ngokwemozulu yasekuhlaleni, amanzi akhoyo nokutyala okulandelayo.

Imizekelo yekhosi ibandakanya i-oats, i-lupins, i-sunn hemp ne-cowpea. Hlola ukufaneleka kwasekuhlaleni ngaphambi kokuhlwayela.

Ii-legume (izityalo ezifana neembotyi) zifuna ibhaktheriya efanelekileyo neemeko zokukhula ukuze zibambe i-nitrogen. Izondlo ezisentsalelweni yazo ziyafumaneka njengoko impahla ibola.

Iifama zeentshulube (worm farms) zinokuguqula intsalela yokutya efanelekileyo nezinto zokulala zibe yinkunkuma yeentshulube (worm castings). Hlola ibhokisi kunokuba ulindele umhla omiselweyo wokuvuna.

Ulwelo oluthontelayo ngokwendalo kwibhokisi yeentshulube lubizwa ngokuba yi-leachate. Aluyonto enye neti yenkunkuma yeentshulube elungisiweyo.

I-leachate inokuba nezinto eziphilayo eziyingozi okanye izinto eziyingozi. Musa ukuyisebenzisa kwizityalo ezityiwayo okanye ucinge ukuba ukuyinciphisa ngamanzi kuyenza ikhuseleke.

Intsimi yaseHighveld eshiywe ingenanto emva kokuvuna umbona ijongene neengozi ezimbini eziphambili.

Umoya wobusika unokuthwala umhlaba ongaphezulu owomileyo.

Isaqhwithi sokuqala esikhulu sentwasahlobo sinokubetha umhlaba ongenanto sonakalise umphezulu nesakhiwo sawo. Ukuba amanzi aqukuqela entsimini, anokuthwala umhlaba okhululekileyo.

Izityalo zokugquma, ingca yokugquma ne-organic matter zinokunceda ukubamba umhlaba endaweni nokuwugcina uphila.
keyPoints: Gcina ingca yokugquma kude neziqu zemithi nezezityalo
Khetha izityalo zokugquma ngokwamanzi, imozulu nesityalo esilandelayo
I-leachate yebhokisi leentshulube ayiyomanyolo ekhuselekileyo ngokuzenzekelayo; yigcine kude nezityalo ezityiwayo

quiz.q: Umfama waseHighveld uvuna umbona ngo-Epreli aze ashiye intsimi ingenanto ubusika bonke. Zeziphi iingozi ezimbini eziphambili?
options: Ukushisa kakhulu elangeni lobusika nokuxhaphaka manzi kwimvula
Iqabaka libulala ubomi bomhlaba kwaye ukhula luthatha indawo kwangethuba
Ukukhukuliseka komhlaba ongaphezulu owomileyo ngumoya nokulahleka kwesakhiwo somhlaba ngenxa yokubetha kwesaqhwithi sentwasahlobo
I-pH yomhlaba iyehla kwaye i-nitrogen iyanda
quiz.rationale: Umhlaba ongenanto uvezekile kumoya wobusika, onokuthwala umhlaba ongaphezulu owomileyo. Ukubetha kwamathontsi emvula kunokonakalisa umphezulu; apho amanzi aqukuqela entsimini, anokuthwala umhlaba okhululekileyo.

quiz.q: Yintoni ekufuneka uyikhumbule ngolwelo oluthontelayo kwibhokisi yeentshulube?
options: Luhlala lukhuselekile kumagqabi esaladi
Lunokuba nezinto eziphilayo eziyingozi okanye izinto eziyingozi; ukunciphisa ngamanzi akuyiso isiqinisekiso sokhuseleko
Lufana ncam nenkunkuma egqityiweyo yeentshulube
Ukunciphisa ngomlinganiselo omiselweyo kwenza lonke ulwelo lukhuseleke
quiz.rationale: I-leachate lulwelo oluthontelayo ngokwendalo kwibhokisi yeentshulube. Ulwakhiwo lwayo luyahluka, ngoko akufuneki ichazwe njengesondlo esikhuselekileyo esiqinisekisiweyo sezityalo ezityiwayo.

lessons.infographicAlt: Amabala amabini omhlaba phantsi kwelanga elinye: umhlaba ongenanto uqhekekile womile, umhlaba ogqunyiweyo usamnyama usafumile.
